name: Isabel Costa
bio:
Isabel's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. After years in traditional marketing, she stumbled upon a local karting event and was captivated by the energy and passion. Sensing an opportunity, she volunteered her marketing skills to the small team and quickly proved her worth. Her success led to roles with larger racing organizations, culminating in her current position with Carlin Academy.

Isabel believes in a data-driven approach to marketing, meticulously tracking campaign performance and constantly seeking innovative ways to connect with fans. She's known for her relentless pursuit of excellence, always pushing her team to exceed expectations and deliver impactful results. Her demanding nature is balanced by her commitment to fostering a collaborative and supportive work environment. 

What sets Isabel apart is her ability to blend traditional marketing principles with a deep understanding of the unique dynamics of motorsport. She's not afraid to challenge the status quo and is always looking for new and exciting ways to engage audiences.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, wavy hair, often pulled back into a practical ponytail.
physical.description: Isabel has a determined look, framed by her practical hairstyle and strong features.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with marketing ideas.
Insists on a daily espresso at precisely 10:00 AM.
Has a habit of tapping her pen when deep in thought.
